My Property Box are delighted to present this stunning HouseShare located on Byron Avenue, Wallsend. This property is available for rent and boasts a range of impressive features.

The property offers six spacious bedrooms with en-suites and one modern bathroom, along with a large shared kitchen that has been recently refurbished and modernised throughout. The property also features kitchenettes in 5 of the rooms, and some rooms with TV's available, making it perfect for those looking for a comfortable and convenient living space.

The property is ideally located close to metro links, providing easy access to the wider area. In addition, street parking is available for those with a vehicle. Each room also comes with its own desk, making it ideal for students or professionals who need to work from home.
